verdicts.rationale: The zero-caveat note only records that the claymore charged attack has no frame data because it is a stamina-drain spin gcsim does not model. Stamina-driven mechanics are constitution-excluded, this CA spin behaves like every other claymore's (nothing Freminet-specific to mislead a player), and the rest is curator process-talk about missing gcsim data. No rendered surface diverges from in-game reality, so no caveat is warranted. The high-plunge sibling note is a working curator convention (lowPlungeFrames used), also nothing to warn about.

verdicts.rationale: The burst unconditionally resets the Elemental Skill CD on cast — a full charge refund, which is exactly the wired `cdReset` effect (source: 'character'), on the CAN list and shipped identically by Kazuha C1 (Q resets skill). This is implement-first: author the effect rather than caveat the gap. Note this is `cdReset` (full refund), NOT the schema-only `cooldownReduce` trap. The reset is base-kit and unconditional, so no condition is needed. After authoring, the timeline zeroes the Pressurized Floe cooldown when the burst fires, leaving no residual divergence.
verdicts.implementSpec: Add one effect to freminet__burst__shadowhunters_ambush.effects (currently []): { type: 'cdReset', source: 'character', target: 'self', trigger: { type: 'onCast', ability: 'burst' }, resets: 'skill' }. No conditions — the reset is base-kit and always fires (unlike Kazuha C1's constellation-gated version). `resets: 'skill'` targets Pressurized Floe (freminet__skill__pressurized_floe). This mirrors the parser-wired character-cdReset path (Kazuha C1: burst onCast, resets skill). Do NOT also touch the separate Subnautical-Hunter 3s skill-CD reduction — that is a different mechanic (cooldownModifiers gated on burst state) outside this candidate.
